description: This source file is a shell script that runs a series of tests related to Perforce (p4) handling of UTF-16 files without BOM. It includes test initialization, depot setup, modifying files to remove BOM, and cloning repositories with expected behaviors.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to Perforce depot with specified file type.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot with a description.

methods.name: p4d
methods.description: Runs the Perforce server daemon with specific options.

methods.name: p4d -jc
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of the Perforce server state.

methods.name: p4 clone
methods.description: Clones depot files into a local git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case that is known to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Runs cleanup or finalization commands after tests.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Performs cleanup on the git repository after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
